references.text: Moses explains that God gives people the power to perform miracles, which can be seen in connection with the accusations against Jesus that he cast out demons by Beelzebub's power.
Describes how the people sacrificed to demons and not to God, reflecting the Pharisees' accusation against Jesus of casting out demons by means of a demon.
A previous incident where the Pharisees accuse Jesus of the same thing: casting out demons by Beelzebub's help.
Jesus is again accused of casting out demons by Beelzebub's help, showing a pattern in the accusations against him.
